items.title: AFCS: Full Episode (Parts 1–5)
items.description: The whole AFCS series as one continuous listen — the control stack, the Collective Safety Function and engagement envelopes, coupled approaches, failure logic, and Automatic Search Modes. Prefer to take it a piece at a time? The same five parts are below, plus a numbers-only cold recap.

items.title: AFCS: The Control Stack
items.description: How the AW189's Automatic Flight Control System is layered — basic attitude and control functions, then the upper modes built on top of them, and how the PFD shows you what's armed, captured or changing.

items.title: AFCS: Collective Safety Function & Engagement Envelopes
items.description: Power Limiting, Autorotation Protection, the full Low Height floor table, Pitch Assist, Airspeed Envelope Protection, and every mode's engagement range and minimum use height.

items.title: AFCS: Coupled Approaches
items.description: The four-degree Category I ILS certification, coupled ILS and GSPD approach speed limits, and the VOR approach/navigation switching rule.

items.title: AFCS: Failure Logic
items.description: The common response pattern behind almost every AFCS malfunction, then how AP FAIL/OFF, trim failures, MISTRIM, AFCS panel failure, oscillatory malfunctions, AHRS failure and AFCS Degraded each build on it.

items.title: AFCS: Automatic Search Modes
items.description: The AW189-specific Search Mode package for SAR and offshore work — TD, TDH, TU, WTR, MOT and Hover Point Approach, their minimum use heights, and the maritime wave-height adjustment.

items.title: AFCS: Cold Recap
items.description: Every number from this series in one pass, no explanation — for the night before a check.
